shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "for file in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$file"; sed -n '"'1,240p' \""'$file"; done; printf '"'\\n--- all files ---\\n'; rg --files"
/bin/bash -c "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next.config.ts ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts"

/bin/bash -c "node --version && npm --version && test -d node_modules && echo 'node_modules present' || true && rg -n 'dynamicIO|cacheComponents|instant\\s*=|revalidate|force-dynamic|use cache|cookies\\(' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' ."
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short --branch && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -c 'git status --short --branch && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- next.config.ts app/news/page.tsx app/preview/page.tsx tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -c "printf 'Generated build files: '; find .next -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l; printf '\\nOpt-out/cache directives:\\n'; rg -n 'dynamicIO|force-dynamic|cacheComponents\\s*=\\s*false|unstable_noStore|dynamic\\s*=' app next.config.ts || true; printf '\\nRelevant route files:\\n'; rg --files app"
/bin/bash -c "nl -ba next.config.ts; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/news/page.tsx; printf '\\n'; nl -ba app/preview/page.tsx"
